dataset.title: Oak (Quercus robur) regeneration in rewilding floodplain the Millingerwaard

abstract.para: Field survey of 292 oak individuals and 50 control plots in the Millingerwaard floodplain area (The Netherlands). Measurements include oak size (DBH, height), browsing damage, thorny shrub structure, woody species composition, dung counts (herbivores and rabbits), soil moisture/temperature/EC (three replicates), and distances to landscape features (paths, water bodies, forest edges).

description.para: Oak and control plots were surveyed using 4x4 m vegetation subplots and 10x10 m dung-count plots. DBH was measured at 130 cm height when possible, or at 20 cm for smaller individuals (flagged separately). Soil properties were measured using handheld moisture, EC, and temperature probes with three replicate readings per plot. Distances to landscape features were derived from GIS layers.
